Identical copies across artifacts counted once per page. Bodies and takeaways with multiple cited evidence pages are conservatively charged to each page. Frozen imports, bibliographic locators/titles, acquisition failures, and procedural author-review/research-note metadata excluded. Full text and origins are retained in source-prose-ledger.json. Cross-shard shared-source reconciliation remains a coordinator responsibility.
